_README: Builtin command visibility and aliases. Values: true (visible + executable), false (hidden + blocked), hidden (works but not shown in ? — dev mode reveals it). _builtin_aliases maps shorthand inputs to canonical commands — applied before prefix expansion, before dispatch.
_comment_aliases: === Builtin Aliases — map shorthand input to canonical command ===
_alias_note: Each key is what the user types (exact match after tokenize); value is the canonical line to dispatch instead.
